text: I feel curiosity welling up inside me as I traverse this space. The modern, sleek glass room beckons with its clean lines and mystery—silent, almost clinical, yet inviting for contemplation. Then, as I face the vibrant display, I am energized by the bold colors and the concept of R+D. Here, knowledge is alive, playful, ever-evolving. I am part of an environment that prizes innovation and discovery, and I sense the pulse of creative minds at work around me. It’s both grounding and inspiring—reminding me of the perpetual dance between intellect and imagination.
